rotation.none: No other scene to go to. Change the source in Settings → Scenes, or allow scenes without walls.
rotation.noFavourite: No other favourite scene yet: star scenes in the scene list (★).
rotation.failed: Scene {id} did not load: back to the one you flew. It is skipped for a day.
set.scenes.autoSwitch.help: On: after a crash the next scene loads instead of a respawn, and you start on its platform. The radio stays connected.
set.scenes.rotation.help: Where N (next scene) and the next scene after a crash come from. Shift+N is always a random scene from the author's list; F is your next favourite.
set.scenes.order.help: Random: every scene once before any comes again, never the one you are in. In order: one after another, round and round.
set.scenes.allowNoWalls.help: Scenes without walls have no crashes: you fly through everything. Off: the rotation skips them.
